summary: Verified M39z.g fix: host Division (persona.body_code == tournament.host_body_id) now acts as organiser with MPCA-equivalent rights on Division-owned tournaments (Inter-District etc.). Backend matrix scope widened correctly; frontend Finance card, persona chip, Pipeline tab, Basics edit affordances all respond to `isOrganiser` semantic. Backend 7/7 pytest and 3/4 frontend flows green; the 4th (DIV-BPL non-host on DIV-IND tournament) short-circuits earlier at GET /tournaments/{id} with a 403 (pre-existing tournament access-control, not part of this ticket) — this is *stricter* than the ticket-required behaviour so the regression concern (no organiser rights leak) is trivially satisfied.

issues: When a persona (e.g. DIV-BPL) opens a tournament they don't have access to, backend returns 403 on GET /tournaments/{id} and the CRA dev-overlay full-screen error is shown (Uncaught runtime errors panel), instead of a graceful 'Access denied' card like the Finance Console has (fc-access-denied). Consider catching the 403 in TournamentDetail.load() and rendering a friendly card. Not caused by this ticket.

action_items: Optional (not blocking): add graceful 403 handling in TournamentDetail.jsx `load()` similar to TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx accessDenied pattern so non-participating personas see a friendly card instead of the dev error overlay. Existing behaviour is unrelated to this ticket.
critical_code_review_comments: finance_console.py L555: is_state now includes `x_body_code == host_body_id` — good, but does NOT also grant IV visibility for districts/parents. Fine for current scope.
TournamentFinanceCard L188: `isOrganiser` computed at render time correctly mirrors deriveAction's own computation. No drift.
TournamentDetail L169: `canEdit = isState || isHostBody` — correctly propagates to Basics/Calendar/Squads sub-panels via prop.
Verify: no other frontend surfaces still hardcode `persona.body_type==='State'` where they should now also allow host body. Quick grep may be useful (Notifications, Extras, Closure Letter panels).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on in-scope flows (3/3 primary + MPCA regression)

test_credentials: localStorage.mpca_persona swapped between MPCA / DIV-IND / DIV-BPL / DIST-INDO-IND
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing tournaments 16a2fdd5 (host=DIV-IND) and bb71efd9 (host=MPCA).
context_for_next_testing_agent: M39z.g adds `isOrganiser = isState || (body_code == host_body_id)`. Any future finance/edit surface added on a Division-hosted tournament should use this same predicate. Backend regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_m39z_g_organiser_rights.py.
